description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy`, which manages HTML tidying/fixes within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties and methods for configuring levels of fixing, loading fixes based on level, and applying transformations to HTML elements to clean up poorly written HTML.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy
classes.description: An abstract class that manages a set of proprietary modules for cleaning up poorly written HTML by applying different levels of fixes (none, light, medium, heavy).

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes and configures the set of fixes to apply based on the provided configuration, including adding and removing fixes.

methods.name: getFixesForLevel
methods.description: Returns a lookup table of fixes applicable for a given level and all lower levels.

methods.name: makeFixesForLevel
methods.description: Populates the `fixesForLevel` property for a default level, based on the set of fixes.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Activates fixes by parsing fix definitions and applying them to appropriate HTML elements or attributes.

methods.name: getFixType
methods.description: Parses a fix name to determine its type and associated parameters for application.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Defines and returns the list of available fixes; intended to be overridden.
